title: Unpinned Seed Sampling with Hash-Dependent Feature Ranking
root_cause: Test uses hash() for feature ranking (PYTHONHASHSEED-sensitive) and module-level random for subset selection (COINFLIP_RANDOM_SEED-sensitive). Under seed_change, both sources are correlated (same run_seed), amplifying threshold failures.

naive_quick_fix.description: Widens threshold from 75.0 to 45.0. Still fails on tail seeds under seed_change.

certified_real_fix.description: Uses local random.Random(42) and removes hash dependency. Fully deterministic, 0% failures.
